marketing.tagline: Program your bots. Conquer the map.

login.title: Login
login.toSignup: Don't have an account? Sign up

signup.title: Sign Up
signup.toLogin: Already have an account? Log in

validation.nameRequired: Please enter your first and last name!
validation.passwordInvalid: The password must have 6-20 characters, a digit, an uppercase and a lowercase Latin letter and a special character: {characters}

forbidden.message: Check your email. We have sent a verification letter
forbidden.resent: If this address is registered and not confirmed yet, we have sent a new letter.

forgot.title: Reset password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If this address is registered, we have sent a link to it.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.success: The password was changed. Log in with the new one.

emailChange.done: Your email was changed. Log in again.
emailChange.failed: The link is invalid or has expired.

accountDeletion.failed: The link is invalid or has expired.

password.title: Change password
password.success: The password was changed. Your other devices were signed out.

email.title: Change email
email.sent: We sent a confirmation link to the new address.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.warning: This erases your personal data. Your base stays on the map as the ruin of a deleted player.
delete.sent: We sent a confirmation link to your email. Follow it to finish.

deploy.title: Deploy your base
deploy.intro: Your base is where everything starts. Set the password others need to connect to it.
deploy.passwordRequired: Please enter a password for your base
deploy.spawnSeedHelp: Players who enter the same code start near each other
deploy.spawnSeedInvalid: 3-24 letters, digits or dashes, for example ALPHA-7K2
deploy.confirmText: Your base is placed on a free spot of the map with its starting equipment. You can deploy only one base.

terminal.notConnected: The terminal is not connected yet

commands.ls: list the drives or the files
commands.cd: change the drive or the directory
commands.rm: delete a file or an empty directory
commands.modules: list the modules of this bot
commands.recipes: list the recipes and what you can craft or research
commands.factory: show the jobs, parts and blueprints of the factory
commands.research: research the blueprint of a higher class
commands.assemble: assemble a bot from module parts
commands.repair: repair a module of a bot on an adjacent cell
commands.disassemble: take a module of a bot on an adjacent cell apart

errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this
errors.CREDENTIALS_INVALID: The email or the password is wrong
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: The link is invalid or has expired
errors.BASE_LOST: This base is lost: deploy a new one
errors.NO_FREE_LOCATION: There is no free place for the base
errors.DRIVE_FULL: There is not enough space on the drive
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests, try again later
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side
errors.NO_DRIVE_SELECTED: No drive selected: use cd with a drive name
errors.NO_MODULE: The bot has no module for this
errors.NO_BLUEPRINT: You do not know this blueprint
errors.NOT_LIVE: The scanner is not in live mode
errors.TOO_HEAVY: The bot is too heavy for its wheels or tracks
